quiz.q: Why did European founding members specifically choose to pool coal and steel production in 1952?
options: To build a collective military alliance against Soviet expansion under a unified command structure.
To subsidize agricultural production and guarantee common minimum prices across all member nations.
To pool essential wartime raw materials so future warfare between European nations became materially impossible.
To introduce a single continental currency and eliminate national central banks through rapid integration.
quiz.why: Founding members pooled coal and steel because those materials manufactured weapons, ensuring war between France and Germany became impossible.

quiz.q: According to the notes, why did major EU nations resist granting full membership to Turkey?
options: Turkey's large population would challenge Germany's voting weight under Lisbon qualified majority rules.
Turkey refused to establish an open market economy compatible with Western European standards.
Turkey demanded permanent opt-out clauses from Schengen border-free travel and human rights treaties.
Turkey insisted on replacing the common euro currency with an independent regional clearing house.
quiz.why: Under Lisbon Treaty qualified majority voting based on population, Turkey's large population would challenge German dominance in EU decision-making.

quiz.q: How did Europhobic countries like Britain and Denmark fundamentally approach European Union integration?
options: They pursued political federalism while rejecting free trade agreements and single market deregulation.
They joined primarily for commercial benefits and negotiated opt-out clauses to preserve national sovereignty.
They financed extensive bailouts to subsidize weaker peripheral economies across Southern and Eastern Europe.
They promoted rapid eastward enlargement to integrate former communist nations into a centralized federation.
quiz.why: Europhobic members like Britain and Denmark joined solely for economic advantages and preserved sovereignty through opt-outs, unlike peace-driven Europhilic founders.

quiz.q: According to the notes, what fundamental structural flaw in Eurozone design triggered the sovereign debt crisis?
options: Member nations retained closed internal borders, preventing the free movement of workers across Europe.
The European Central Bank lacked legal authority to monitor national inflation rates across candidate members.
The European Parliament lacked directly elected representatives to approve emergency financial stabilization loans.
Member nations created a monetary union sharing a single currency without establishing a unified fiscal union.
quiz.why: The notes explain that the basic flaw of the Eurozone was creating a monetary union without corresponding fiscal and economic integration.
